run_iterative_refinement_trials: run multiple trials of iterative refinement and collect success rate statistics
run_trials_with_custom_iterations: run iterative refinement trials with a custom number of trials and max iterations per trial
run_trials_default_config: run ten iterative refinement trials with one hundred max iterations using default config
summarize_trial_results: summarize iterative refinement trial results including success rate and average iterations to solution
save_trial_results_to_json: save iterative refinement trial results and statistics to a JSON file
